name: Goldfield Grainworks
tagline: Heritage grains, winter squash and beans dried on the stalk.
imageAlt: A pile of pumpkins and winter squash
stand: Barn store open daily in autumn, 10am–5pm
description: In Petaluma, CA, Goldfield Grainworks grows Winter squash, Sweet corn, Heirloom beans, and Pumpkins on a working pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. It follows cover-cropped, stone-milled on site, and seed-saving practices. It has been growing since 1994. The season runs through autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
